verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own workflow automation, such as routing leads and updating fields when a deal closes. These are event-triggered automations that run without user intervention. It also offers AI agents that execute tasks on the user's behalf, and Zia can generate workflows on request. The evidence is marketing-level and shallow on how these run in the background. Missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled triggers, detail on how autonomous agents run unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate repetitive tasks with workflows. From routing leads to the right rep to updating fields when a deal is closed.
Build and deploy AI agents that execute tasks on your behalf for any business use case.
Zia can create modules, reports, and workflows in seconds
